scriptData.label: Hunter (Kill Count)

description.label: Description
description.value:
Kill Count Rank: Hunter

Enemy Type: Free text. Set flags.wfrp4e-nom.killCountEnemy and/or rename this talent to Hunter (Enemy) when awarding. Suggested examples: Beastmen, Orcs, Undead, Outlaws, Skaven, Chaos. Foe-specific bonuses do not apply while Enemy Type is blank.

Progression: For a single Enemy Type only the highest rank remains active (Reaper > Killer > Hunter). When awarding a higher rank, remove or supersede the lower rank for that enemy.

Requirements: The warrior has been blooded against a particular enemy of the Empire, with a few successful encounters against that adversary under their belt. Optionally, the GM might wish to keep a full tally of the enemies they have killed. If this is the case, this Kill Count is awarded for 50 or more confirmed kills of a given enemy of the Empire by the character.

Bonuses: You are well versed in discerning the movements, trails and patterns for the given enemy. You gain a +10 bonus to Perception and Psychology Tests related to the specific enemy on your travels (such as Tests to track them and Tests to avoid Surprise or Fear in combat).

Medal Notes (Kill Counts)

Kill Counts are informal honors (no physical medal required). Recipient rules for talents still apply; the GM enforces awards and superseding ranks.
